notes: Page 6 of 10 (printed 'Page TR 4', the fourth of eight numbered return pages; pages 1-2 are an unnumbered info sheet). Chosen over TR3 (page 5, 21 currency combs but no checkbox) and TR6 (page 8, richer mix but its sort code/account number/building-society combs are not the currency-comb shape and it adds a signature field this pass leaves for a page picked to show one) as the page with the SA100's three core answer shapes together: 11 currency combs, 3 tick boxes and 1 free-text area, all with numbered captions above-left, none of the 4 AcroForm widgets (all on page 3), and no narrative/notes-only content. Every bound is the real vector ink from collectPageInk (src/editor/adapters/pdf/pageInk.js) on this exact page, not eyeballed from the render: each currency box is drawn as 11 separate painted rects (1 unfilled '£' cell + 8 filled writable digit cells + 2 unfilled pre-set '.00' pence cells), each tick box and digit cell share one 13.673x16.508pt footprint, and box 14's two answer lines paint as a single 216.351x33.516pt rect. The small unfilled 19.34x11.5pt rects beside each caption are the printed box-number badges (e.g. the '1', '13') and are excluded as caption, not field.
